name: Hornero Calculator
description: Utility Tools 2.0 calculator: bar quick action and compact dashboard detail over a safe tokenizer/recursive-descent parser (+ - * / %, parentheses, decimals, unary minus). Division by zero shows Error.
author: HorneroOS contributors

changelog.notes: Utility Tools 2.0 (plugins#30): bar quick action with popover, compact Utilities dashboard detail panel and a declaration-only launcher entrypoint (not loaded until shell#250) over one tested pure-JS logic block; typed settings default to 1.x behaviour; Spanish catalog.
Dashboard calculator with a safe tokenizer and recursive-descent parser; division by zero showed Error.

showKeypad.description: Show the keypad grid in the dashboard panel (the 1.x behaviour).

liveResult.description: Recompute the bar quick action as you type; off keeps 1.x explicit compute on Enter or =.
